name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. The damage increases by 1d10 at levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature you can see within range, dealing 1d4+1 force damage. Casting at a higher level creates one additional dart per slot level above 1st.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Casting at a higher level heals an additional 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Mage Armor

mechanics.effect: target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier for 8 hours

description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Casting at a higher level heals an additional 1d4 per slot level above 1st.

name: Bless

mechanics.effect: up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws

description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to the roll. Casting at a higher level targets one additional creature per slot level above 1st. Requires concentration.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Casting at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Shield of Faith

mechanics.effect: a creature gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration

description: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration. Requires concentration.
